$comment: Every entry REQUIRES a non-empty `reason`. An unexplained entry is a mute button,
so a missing reason is a hard error (exit 2), not a warning. This file is how a
deliberate security-documentation example is DECLARED rather than silenced:
'why is this allowed' is answered in the repository, not in someone's memory.
file    - repo-relative path, or "*" for repo-wide (required)
pattern - RegExp source, matched against the RAW matched text (required)
rule    - rule name to narrow the entry; omit to cover every rule (optional)
reason  - why this is safe. Non-empty. (required)
